mapper.select: select cgi.grade_id, cgi.competition_series_id, cgi.competition_stage_id, cgi.competition_track_id, cgi.second_level_code, cgi.course_id, cgi.training_program_id, cgi.member_id, cgi.user_id, cgi.score, cgi.team_code, cgi.grade_source, cgi.create_by, cgi.create_time, cgi.update_by, cgi.update_time, cgi.del_flag, cgi.version, cgi.user_name,cai.phone, cgi.id_card, cai.email,cai.leader_teacher_id,cai.competition_role_name, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(cgi.score AS DECIMAL(10,2)) DESC) as ranking, csi.competition_series_name,csi.competition_name,cti.competition_track_name,ctc.second_level_name,csc.stage_name from competition_grade_info cgi left join (select a.competition_series_id, a.competition_series_name,b.competition_name from competition_series_info a left join competition_main_info b on a.competition_id = b.competition_id) csi on cgi.competition_series_id = csi.competition_series_id left join competition_track_info cti on cgi.competition_track_id = cti.competition_track_id left join competition_track_config ctc on cgi.second_level_code = ctc.second_level_code left join competition_apply_info cai on cai.member_id = cgi.member_id LEFT JOIN competition_stage_config csc on csc.stage_id = cgi.competition_series_id where cgi.del_flag = '0' and cgi.grade_id = #{gradeId}
